title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-evan-ramirez
content:
Meeting: Release Train - weekly prep (go/no-go)
Date: 2026-03-04 meeting (sync before Friday canary)
Owner: Evan Ramirez
Attendees: Priya, Jamie, Samir, Taylor, Evan

Objective: Quick run-through of go/no-go checklist, confirm owners for fixes, align rollout window and rollback plan.

Quick status summary:
- Release branch: release/2026.03.07 (green)
- CI: all unit + integration tests passing; nightly perf bench unstable (see RL-4285)
- Canary infra: 6 nodes reserved in us-west-2 (dedicated pool)
- DB migration: scheduled but not yet run in staging (blocked by RL-4301)

Go/No-Go checklist (vote required from leads):
1) Code freeze in effect - no non-critical merges (Owner: Evan) - YES (ok)
2) CI green on mainline, critical tests passed - (Owner: Jamie) - YES
3) Performance regressions within threshold - (Owner: Priya) - NO (investigating RL-4285)
4) Smoke tests for canary image - (Owner: Samir) - YES
5) DB migration dry-run completed in staging - (Owner: Taylor) - NO (blocked)
6) Observability dashboards ready (alerts, SLOs) - (Owner: Priya) - PARTIAL
7) Rollback playbook validated and owner assigned - (Owner: Evan) - YES

Major blockers / risks:
- RL-4285: perf regression on long-tail prompt distributions causing 10-15% p95 increase. Root cause suspected quantization kernel selection on new runtime build. (Priya)
- RL-4301: DB migration script failing on staging due to permission error; blocked on infra change request and IAM policy update. (Taylor)
- Canary capacity: extra warmup time required; may delay canary start by ~30m.

Contingency decisions discussed:
- If perf regression not fixed by cutoff (EOD 2026-03-04), fallback plan: pin to previous runtime kernel ABI and restrict to 50% traffic for first 2 hours. (Owner: Evan)
- If DB migration not resolved, ship without migration and gate feature flag behind rollout (low-risk). (Owner: Taylor)

Action items (owners, due):
- Priya: deep-dive on RL-4285, reproduce locally, try rollback to kernel ABI v1.2 (due: 2026-03-04 EOD)
- Taylor: escalate IAM change, coordinate with infra, attempt staging migration dry-run (due: 2026-03-04 noon)
- Samir: finalize canary smoke test script and run once migration is ready (due: 2026-03-04 3pm)
- Jamie: prepare rollback PR and verify automated rollback triggers (due: 2026-03-04 5pm)
- Evan: update release notes, send pre-launch email to SRE and customer-support with expected window (due: 2026-03-04 6pm)

Rollout window:
- Planned: 2026-03-07 02:00-04:00 UTC (low-traffic)
- Canary: 10% traffic for 30 minutes -> 50% for 1 hour -> 100% if metrics OK

Communication plan:
- Slack channel: #release-train (use thread with RL-4285 tag)
- Pager: on-call SRE (Samir) responsible for immediate pager triage during canary
- Customer notice: draft in Confluence + #cs-review (Evan)

Notes / questions to resolve:
- Do we have enough capacity in eu-west-1 if us-west-2 experiences issues? (asked Priya)
- Confirm cost impact if we extend canary beyond planned window (finance notified?)

Next sync: 2026-03-04 17:30 UTC (final go/no-go call)

Quick links:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RELEASE/Release+Train+Q1-2026
- Jira: RL-4285, RL-4301
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts/pull/215

Notes to self: keep this doc as single source for go/no-go comments. Convert to formal runbook once blockers cleared.
